description: This file defines the ScorecardService class, which manages scorecard operations such as creation and retrieval based on survey and client data within the Fineract platform.

classes.name: ScorecardService
classes.description: A service class for managing scorecards, including creation and retrieval based on survey and client information.

methods.name: createScorecard
methods.description: Creates scorecards after ensuring the user is authenticated.

methods.name: findBySurvey
methods.description: Retrieves scorecards associated with a specific survey after authentication.

methods.name: findBySurveyAndClient
methods.description: Retrieves scorecards associated with a specific survey and client after authentication.
